official.application_cycle: 2027 call: opens 17 September 2026, closes 16 November 2026 at 5pm; fellowship starts 1 October or 1 November 2027
official.status_note: The FWO page lists the call status as Open; the last application date is 16 November 2026 at 5pm, with preselection 18-25 March 2027, interviews 14 April - 5 May 2027 and results on 13 May 2027.
official.funding_period: per month (gross salary, 4 yrs seniority) + bench fee/yr
benefits: Gross monthly salary of EUR 5,616.81 for a researcher with four years of seniority (index 2.1647 on 1 March 2026)
Fixed operating allowance (bench fee) of EUR 4,000 to EUR 10,000 per year
eligibility: PhD by thesis, or a degree, diploma or certificate recognised as equivalent under European Union directives or a bilateral agreement

PhD obtained no longer than 3 years before 1 October of the year in which the fellowship starts, or obtained by 15 September of that year at the latest (in which case the public defence date must be notified to the FWO by 1 July)
A supervisor at a Flemish host institution
No previous benefit from a junior postdoctoral fellowship, not even partially
Maximum two applications for the same fellowship; from the 2027 call a second application is only possible if the first ranked in the top 50% of the preselection
Agreement to the FWO Research Integrity Clause
requirements: Find a supervisor at a Flemish host institution (article 3 of the postdoctoral regulations)
Submit the application via the FWO online application portal (fwoweb.fwo.be), addressed to the FWO expert panel that best matches the project scope
The supervisor must submit a letter of recommendation - a mandatory component and an evaluation criterion confirming commitment, expertise, research infrastructure and the fellowship's added value

The application is addressed to a panel whose scope covers the project; panels may reject applications judged out of scope, and matching the application to the correct panel is the applicant's responsibility
documents: Online application form submitted through the FWO e-portal
Mandatory letter of recommendation from the supervisor, following the FWO guidelines
selection_criteria: Two-round assessment: online preselection meetings (18-25 March 2027), then interviews (14 April - 5 May 2027) for candidates invited on 26 March 2027
The FWO board makes the final decision on the basis of the expert panels' proposals; results announced 13 May 2027
Scoring grids cover preselection and interview stages and value a broad range of researcher profiles and research outputs
coverage: Gross monthly salary of EUR 5,616.81 (4 years seniority, index 2.1647 on 1 March 2026)
Bench fee of EUR 4,000 to EUR 10,000 per year
application_method: Secure a supervisor at a Flemish host institution before submitting
Submit the application via the FWO online portal at fwoweb.fwo.be, addressed to the best-matching FWO expert panel, before 16 November 2026 at 5pm
Ensure the supervisor's letter of recommendation is submitted as a mandatory component
official.application_route: Apply online via the FWO e-portal (fwoweb.fwo.be) with a Flemish host supervisor, addressed to an FWO expert panel, by 5pm on 16 November 2026.
official.citizenship_residency: No nationality or residency restriction is stated; the host institution must be in Flanders.
official.international_eligibility: Open to researchers internationally, provided the PhD is by thesis or an equivalent recognised degree and the host is a Flemish institution.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Fellowships funded in association with Plantentuin Meise, VITO and WL (Flanders Hydraulics) carry their own conditions; the Suzanne Duchesne Fund provides EUR 50,000 in special bench fees for the 2027 call for selected postdoctoral researchers in oncology (Med4 panel).
official.research_requirement: The applicant develops their own research line at a Flemish host institution under a supervisor; the project scope determines the expert panel to which the application is addressed.
official.duration: 3 years, no extension possible; start on 1 October or 1 November 2027
official.description: The FWO junior postdoctoral fellowship supports researchers who have recently obtained their doctorate to further specialise in their research discipline, develop their own research line while acquiring additional academic skills through training and mobility, giving young researchers optimal opportunities to build an independent international research career, either within an academic context or beyond.

not_confirmed: tuition_coverage and travel_coverage - the FWO page publishes salary and bench fee only and does not state tuition or travel coverage
english_requirement - no language requirement is stated on the official page
the exact mobility arrangements (type and amount of any mobility budget) are set out in the programme regulations rather than on the call page
verification.notes: Salary (EUR 5,616.81 gross per month at 4 years seniority, index 2.1647 on 1 March 2026), bench fee (EUR 4,000-10,000 per year), duration, all key dates, eligibility rules and the supervisor letter requirement confirmed on the official FWO call page. The FWO page does not publish a tuition or travel coverage statement, so those fields remain null and fully_funded is not asserted.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a salaried three-year Flemish research fellowship: a gross EUR 5,616.81 per month plus a bench fee of EUR 4,000-10,000 per year, with no extension possible, so treat the project you propose as your complete postdoctoral agenda. The application is built around your Flemish supervisor: their letter of recommendation is now a scoring criterion in its own right, and from the 2027 call a supervisor can back at most five applications per call across junior and senior fellowships - so agree support with them well before November. The two-round process (preselection 18-25 March 2027, interviews 14 April - 5 May 2027, results 13 May 2027) means the panel must grasp your project from the written application alone before you ever meet them.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Researchers within three years of their PhD defence who can name a committed supervisor at a Flemish university or research institute and want a three-year salaried fellowship to build an independent research line.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your defence falls within the 3-year window before 1 October 2027 - if you defend by 15 September 2027, you must tell FWO your defence date by 1 July 2027
Line up a Flemish host supervisor early and confirm they have capacity under the five-applications-per-supervisor limit for the 2027 call
Brief your supervisor on the letter of recommendation guidelines so the letter evidences commitment, infrastructure and the fellowship's added value for both sides
Study the FWO expert panel scopes and address your application to the panel that will actually assess it - a scope mismatch is itself a rejection ground
Read the preselection and interview scoring grids before writing, and attend one of the FWO information sessions (VUB, UGent, UHasselt, KU Leuven or UAntwerp dates published on the call page)
common_rejection_risks: Addressing the application to the wrong expert panel - panels can reject applications they judge out of scope
A weak or missing supervisor letter, which is mandatory and weighted in the evaluation
A PhD obtained more than 3 years before the fellowship start year, or a defence date not notified to FWO on time
A second application after a first attempt that did not rank in the top 50% of preselection - barred from the 2027 call onwards
Applications read as a generic publication list rather than a coherent, self-directed research line
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The salary and bench fee cover the post and research costs, but the FWO page does not publish tuition or travel coverage - relocation to Flanders, visa costs, conference fees beyond any allowance in the regulations, and personal living setup are on you until the award letter and regulations confirm otherwise.
document_audit: The supervisor's recommendation letter must follow the FWO template and guidelines, not a personal format
Equivalent non-EU PhDs rely on recognition under EU directives or a bilateral agreement - have the equivalence documentation ready
The application must be submitted through the FWO e-portal addressed to a specific panel; an unaddressed submission is not evaluated as intended
alerts: The call closes at exactly 5pm on 16 November 2026 - portal congestion on the final afternoon is a real risk
There is no extension of the three years under any circumstances, so the project must be deliverable within 36 months
If you are under 3 years post-PhD and targeting a senior fellowship later, note a junior fellowship does not bar an immediate senior application
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Secure a Flemish supervisor, draft the project for a specific FWO expert panel, submit via fwoweb.fwo.be before 5pm on 16 November 2026 with the supervisor's letter attached, then await preselection (18-25 March 2027), interview invitation (26 March 2027), interviews (14 April - 5 May 2027) and results (13 May 2027).
